defs.def: the process of choosing a person or a group of people for a position, especially a political position, by voting 选举，推选（尤指从政）

ex.s: Freedom Day is held every year on 27 April to celebrate South Africa’s first fully-participated elections in 1994, in which everyone was allowed to vote regardless of skin colour.
ex.t: 每年4月27日是自由日，庆祝南非1994年首次全民参与的选举，在这次选举中，无论肤色如何，每个人都被允许投票。

ex.s: One reason is that although I’ve been working ever since leaving school, I won’t be voting in the next general election.
ex.t: 一个原因是，虽然我自从离开学校就一直在工作，但我不会在下次大选中投票。

defs.def: the fact of having been chosen by election 当选

ex.s: The year 2022 will be another historic moment for China, as Beijing won the election to host the Winter Olympics.
ex.t: 2022年对中国来说将是另一个历史性时刻，因为北京赢得了举办冬季奥运会的主办权。
